_about: Per-file style rolls for extract.py. Each roll picks one option by weight (seeded by file name) and fills {<roll>} and {<roll>_instruction} in that entity type's prompts. Weights within a roll are relative.

Standard.instruction: Usually 70-100 words. One or two short paragraphs, or a short opening plus 2-3 bullets.

Detailed.instruction: Usually 100-140 words. Use this only when the source supports several distinct tasks within the one gig.

Task first.instruction: Open with the work itself, as a direct instruction or a noun phrase (e.g. "Redesign [process] so that..." or "Migration of [system] to..."). No pronoun in the first sentence.

Context first.instruction: Open with one sentence setting the scene in the third person (e.g. "A [type of organisation] is [situation]."), then say what is needed. Avoid "we" throughout.

Problem first.instruction: Open with the problem the hirer has run into (e.g. "Our month-end close takes twelve days and ..." or "Customer complaints about late deliveries doubled this year."), then say what work is needed. Don't describe the ideal candidate.

Individual poster.instruction: Write as the one manager posting the gig, using "I" and "my team" (e.g. "I run [function] at a [type of organisation] and need..."). Don't invent a name or a job title the source doesn't support.

Organisation.instruction: Write as the organisation, using "we" and "our" sparingly, and do not begin the first sentence with "We".

Descriptive.instruction: State their core role and specialization plainly and factually -- no authority framing, no sales hook (e.g., "Senior Management Consultant specializing in supply chain transformation for retail clients").

Authority.instruction: Rewrite their core role as an official corporate/industry-leader title (e.g., "Former Head of [Field] & Industry Leader").

Value Prop.instruction: Rewrite their core role as a client-focused, benefit-driven hook (e.g., "Smart Financing as you Deserve").

Direct First-Person.instruction: Use explicit "I" pronouns with active verbs (e.g., "I managed...", "I led..."). Cap at 3 items.

Implied First-Person.instruction: Drop pronouns completely. Start directly with punchy action verbs (e.g., "Managed...", "Led..."). Cap at 3 items.

none.instruction: none; use flawless grammar and punctuation.

double_connecting_word.instruction: Accidental double connecting word (e.g., "for the the project")

mid_sentence_tense_switch.instruction: Unintentionally switch grammatical tense mid-sentence (e.g., "led the team and develops new strategies")

omitted_trailing_period.instruction: Leave the final sentence without its period
